run_benchmark_notification_success: run the benchmark notification script with success status to send a Slack message about completed benchmarks
run_benchmark_notification_failure: run the benchmark notification script with failure status to send a Slack alert about a failed workflow
review_main_function: review the main function that constructs a Slack message and posts it via a webhook based on the workflow status
refactor_main_slack_webhook: refactor the main function to support a different notification channel instead of the Slack webhook
summarize_notify_benchmarking_status: summarize the notify benchmarking status script that sends success or failure notifications to Slack via a webhook
